$comment: HumanGateway protocol v1.0.0 (2026-08-28). AUTH-FR-02, SP-03, SP-07.
title: User
description: A local Edge user account (AUTH-FR-02). Users authenticate at the Edge with a username and password; successful logins issue signed opaque session tokens (v1 — identity-security Open Q #1). This entity is the Edge-local store representation: 'passwordVerifier' is the credential verifier (PHC string) and MUST NEVER be transmitted in any protocol payload — it exists only in Edge storage (SP-07). A user is referenced from message flows via participant.userId on human: participants. HumanGateway performs no role-checking (SP-09): what a user may access is governed by conversation/task membership, enforced by authorisation middleware (AUTH-FR-03). Remote users who log in at the Relay follow the same shape with a Relay-issued user record (external-web-access).

id.description: Durable local user ID. Referenced from participant.userId for human participants.

username.description: Login username. Normalised to lowercase; matching is case-insensitive.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the UI.

passwordVerifier.description: Password verifier in PHC string format (e.g. argon2id, bcrypt). Edge-local store field ONLY — never transmitted in protocol payloads and never logged (SP-07).

status.description: ACTIVE users may log in; DISABLED users are rejected at authentication time.

lastLoginAt.description: When the user last authenticated successfully.

disabledAt.description: When the user was disabled. Required when status is DISABLED.

createdAt.description: When the user record was created.

updatedAt.description: When the user record last changed.

allOf.description: DISABLED must record when it was disabled.
